name: app-black-nav-bar-with-lime-home-circle-and-icon-pill
title: Black Nav Bar with Lime Home Circle
whatItIs: A black field with a floating navigation made of a lime circular home button beside a dark grey pill holding white star, card, bag and search icons.
whatItMeans: Separating the active item into its own lime circle makes the current location unmistakable, and a dark pill keeps the rest quiet.
techniques: Active item in a separate lime circle
Inactive items grouped in a dark pill
Very small component isolated for focus

vocabulary.definition: A selected tab drawn as a separate shape from the bar.
A capsule holding a row of icons.
A coloured circle marking the active state.
